newsitem.title: CANADA: Altai strikes deal with Normandy.
newsitem.headline: Altai strikes deal with Normandy.

text.p: Altai Resources Inc, a Canadian exploration company, said on Monday it has established a strategic alliance with Australia's Normandy Mining Ltd.

Altai said Normandy will be issued 805,000 units of Altai, or 10 percent of the company, at an issue price of C$1.50 per unit. Each unit will consist of one common share and one common share purchase warrant.
Each purchase warrant will entitle Normany to buy an additional share of Altai at C$2 in the first year, C$2.50 in the second year or C$3 in the third year.
In return, Normandy will have a right to earn a 50 percent direct interest in four of Altai's Phillipines properties, Altai said.

Normany will have to spend US$8 million over four years at the Mabulao gold and copper property, US$8 million over five years at the Lahuy Island gold property, US$6 million over four years at the Bulan gold property and US$4 million over four years at the Mindoro copper-zinc-gold project.
Normandy will the operator of the exploration joint venture, Altai said. ((Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100))
